summary: The 'CriminalRecordsCheckEditAll' user control is responsible for editing, validating, and saving the criminal records check status for multiple students within a cohort/session in an enrollment system. It presents a grid interface (GridView) to view, update, and manage students' CRC details, supports filtering, paging, sorting, and handles security controls for read-only and modification scenarios.
purpose: Enable authorized users to view and edit criminal records check (CRC) information across multiple students efficiently, providing bulk update mechanisms, validations, status tracking, and seamless navigation in context of student enrollment workflow.

workflows.name: Edit All CRC Records
steps: User accesses the CRC Edit All screen with session and filter context.
GridView loads student CRC data based on filters, paging, sorting, and user session.
User reviews and edits CRC-related fields per student: status, date, notes.
UI marks rows as dirty (unsaved changes) using JavaScript and hidden fields.
User can bulk save changes (Save All), save single row (Save), or navigate to next set.
System validates input (presence, format, permissions) and disables/enables edit controls based on read-only state.
On save, system updates student CRC data, checks for warnings, and redirects appropriately.
Buttons and controls are dynamically shown/hidden based on number of rows, paging, read-only state, and workflow context.

business_rules: Save All and Cancel buttons are hidden if fewer than 14 rows are present (no scrollbars needed).
Save, Save All, and Save Edit Next buttons are only shown when not in read-only mode.
Edit fields are disabled when system is in read-only state.
Dropdown must be populated with CRC status codes from lookup and pre-selected based on student data.
UserSession must be valid; otherwise, data selection is cancelled.
validations: Row-level tracking of unsaved changes using hidden field and JavaScript (txtDirty).
CRCStatusCode and CRCStatusDate fields validated for input and format.
UserSession validation on data selection and updates.
Warnings checked post-update; redirect suppressed if warnings found.
calculations: Grid paging calculation using StartRow and PageSize.
Sorting calculation using SortExpression and SortDirection.
conditions: If EnrollmentID > 0: Footer button controls are hidden.
If EnrollmentID == 0: Header Save All/Cancel buttons hidden if rows < 14.
If rows count < PageSize: Next page controls hidden.
If blnReadOnly: Edit controls disabled, calendars disabled.
If UserSession is null: Data retrieval cancelled.
system_behavior: GridView initializes and binds to ObjectDataSource (dsCRC).
Controls are shown/hidden based on context and workflow.
JavaScript variables are generated for row-dirty tracking and injected at runtime (async and sync postback).
Bulk update logic traverses all rows, updates each student CRC if marked dirty.
Redirect logic after saving/cancelling dependent on warnings and command type.
Dropdown controls populated on row bound event from lookup codes.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, data operation is cancelled.
If warnings exist after updating CRCs, redirect is prevented.
content_gaps: No explicit field-level CRC validation logic is described.
Workflow branching and error handling specifics are limited.
No description of user interface layout or exact field types.
